exact.F8也可切换。正常打开军械库的生涯页即可查看档案。关闭界面后仍记录真实战果与账单: F8 toggles the display. Open Armory > Career normally to view your archive. Awards and costs keep recording while hidden.
exact.记录后续作战消费，并在战斗及生涯显示爱国账单。关闭时停止新增费用，保留已有账目。: Record combat spending and show the Patriotic Bill in battle and Career. Turning this off stops new charges and keeps existing records.
exact.选择战争账单的显示币种。: Choose the currency used to display war costs.
exact.默认跟随游戏HUD边缘偏移；命中、绶带、成就与战果数字共用右边缘。: Follows the game HUD margin by default. Hit feedback, ribbons, medals and counters share the same right edge.
exact.累计绶带可始终显示；打开地图还会在成就下显示四类命中累计，零命中不显示。: Ribbon totals can stay visible. Opening the map also shows four hit totals below medals; zero totals are hidden.
exact.仅调整即时命中提示；仍记录真实命中，打开地图可查看累计。绶带与成就保留在右侧。: Only moves live hit feedback. Hits are still recorded and totals appear on the map. Ribbons and medals stay on the right.
exact.独立选择每次消费的提示位置；关闭提示仍正常累计战争账单。: Choose where charge notifications appear. Hiding them does not stop cost tracking.
exact.显示最近一次的击杀目标和来源，5秒后消失。关闭只隐藏提示，武器击杀、绶带和生涯仍: Show the latest target and kill source for 5 seconds. Hiding this keeps weapon kills, ribbons and Career recording. Re-enabling shows new kills.
exact.界面显示时增加原生任务前间距；资源栏和计时器保留位置。关闭此项或按F8隐藏界面可: Add space above objectives while the HUD is visible. Resources and the timer stay in place. Disable this or hide the HUD with F8 to restore spacing.
exact.任务列表与右上战果区域之间的额外空隙，按画面缩放自适应。: Extra space between objectives and the top-right combat HUD. Scales with the display.
exact.启动游戏后在舰上即可完成；只读取两处缺失的布局函数，共14KiB，每步至多4Ki: Runs aboard the ship after launch. Reads two missing layout functions: 14 KiB total, up to 4 KiB per step. Stops after success; no mission or manual capture required. Existing UI samples are kept.
exact.登录上舰和任务返回飞船后，短时核对游戏的真实生涯计数。同步后停止读取；战斗中使用: Briefly sync actual Career counters on arrival aboard the ship and after missions. Reading stops after sync; combat uses the latest result.
exact.在飞船打开自己的完整生涯统计页，保持约3秒，即可同步。关闭页面后保留最近结果；战: Open your full Career statistics aboard the ship for about 3 seconds to sync. The latest result is kept after closing; no reading during combat.
exact.选择后按应用。演示三行通知、成就名称、数字动画与扣费提示；8秒后结束，舰上也可测: Choose and apply to preview three notification rows, medal names, animated counters and charges for 8 seconds. Works aboard the ship and does not alter awards or bills.
exact.应用后5秒开始等待对应地图状态（最多30秒）。关闭菜单，保持该状态约15秒。仅手: After applying, close the menu. A 5-second delay is followed by up to 30 seconds waiting for the selected map state. Keep that state for about 15 seconds. Manual only; reads up to 64 KiB and saves about 4.7 MiB in local HD2Runtime/mod_data.
exact.应用后关闭菜单并留在飞船；5秒后运行2秒并恢复入口。每次游戏启动只运行一次，结果: Apply, close the menu and stay aboard the ship. After 5 seconds, runs for 2 seconds and restores the entry point. Once per game launch; saves local diagnostics without altering awards or bills.
exact.摧毁敌方飞船或机器人构造者；普通虫洞实际封闭并与本人爆炸关联，竞争爆炸仅作为证据: Destroy an enemy ship or Automaton Fabricator, or seal a regular bug hole with an explosion linked to you. Competing explosions are retained as evidence only.
exact.使用火焰或燃烧伤害击杀 1 个敌方单位。: Kill 1 enemy with fire or burning damage.
exact.一局中每累计射击 1,000 发，获得 1 次。: Earn once for every 1,000 shots fired in a mission.
exact.战斗中使用 2 级或以下穿甲的武器，击杀 1 个重型或巨型敌方单位。: Kill 1 heavy or giant enemy with a weapon of armor penetration level 2 or lower.
exact.一场战斗中碾压击杀 100 个敌方单位。: Run over 100 enemies in one mission.
exact.成为游戏发现通知指认的支线任务或敌方据点发现者。: Be named by the game as the discoverer of a secondary objective or enemy outpost.
exact.获得 1 次游戏记录的命中。: Land 1 hit recorded by the game.
exact.本人弹丸命中敌方装甲并发生实际反弹。: Have your projectile ricochet off enemy armor.
exact.本人弹丸命中敌方单位，但未击穿装甲。: Hit an enemy with a projectile that fails to penetrate its armor.
exact.本人弹丸击穿敌方装甲，造成部分装甲倍率伤害。: Penetrate enemy armor with a projectile at reduced damage.
exact.本人弹丸击穿敌方装甲，获得完整装甲倍率。: Penetrate enemy armor with a projectile at full damage.
exact.一命中每击杀 100 个轻型敌方单位，获得 1 次。: Earn once for every 100 light enemies killed in one life.
exact.极短时间内连续击杀两只巨型单位: Kill two giant enemies in rapid succession.
exact.一段连杀中每累计击杀 5 个敌方单位，获得 1 次；相邻击杀间隔不超过 5 秒，: Earn once for every 5 enemies in a killstreak. Keep kills within 5 seconds of each other; death resets the streak.
exact.载具车体来源每击杀1个敌方单位，获得1次。: Earn once for each enemy killed by your vehicle's body.
exact.一段连杀击杀 50 个敌人（已确认机器人 30 个）；相邻击杀间隔不超过 5 秒: Kill 50 enemies in one streak (30 confirmed Automatons). Keep kills within 5 seconds of each other; death resets the streak.
exact.一段连杀击杀 80 个敌人（已确认机器人 50 个）；相邻击杀间隔不超过 5 秒: Kill 80 enemies in one streak (50 confirmed Automatons). Keep kills within 5 seconds of each other; death resets the streak.
exact.一段连杀击杀 100 个敌人（已确认机器人 60 个）；相邻击杀间隔不超过 5: Kill 100 enemies in one streak (60 confirmed Automatons). Keep kills within 5 seconds of each other; death resets the streak.
exact.一局击杀 36 个终结族、12 个机器人或 24 个光能者空中单位；按阵营分别累: Kill 36 Terminid, 12 Automaton or 24 Illuminate airborne units in one mission. Each faction is counted separately.
exact.一局摧毁 10 艘光能族飞船。: Destroy 10 Illuminate ships in one mission.
exact.累计使用火焰或燃烧伤害击杀 500 个敌方单位。: Kill a total of 500 enemies with fire or burning damage.
exact.这个时段没有已保存的战果。: No awards recorded in this period.
exact.暂无已保存的账单。旧对局缺少金额时保留未记录。: No bills saved. Missing costs in old missions remain unrecorded.
exact.缺少该时点的生涯记录: No Career record at that time
exact.本场尚无已保存的明细。: No details saved for this mission.
exact.本场没有保存的战果或成就。: No awards or medals saved for this mission.
exact.悬停图案，查看获取条件。: Hover over an icon for requirements.
exact.该时段暂无已保存对局: No missions saved in this period
exact.滚轮浏览 · 仅汇总已保存的实际费用: Scroll to browse. Saved actual costs only.
exact.滚轮浏览 · 悬停查看条件: Scroll to browse. Hover for requirements.
exact.仅汇总已保存的实际费用；未记录的旧局不补造金额。: Only saved actual costs are included. Missing costs in old missions are not reconstructed.
exact.已包含中途返回舰船的记录；悬停图案查看条件。: Includes early returns to the ship. Hover over an icon for requirements.
exact.暂时无法粘贴，请重试。: Cannot paste right now. Try again.
exact.输入型号/ID，中文可粘贴: Type a model or ID; paste Chinese text.
exact.计数增加时未确认角色已阵亡: Death not confirmed when counter increased
exact.会话标识不能代替永久账号。: A session ID is not a permanent account ID.
exact.缺少明细的阵亡汇入未知死因。: Deaths without details are grouped under Unknown cause.
exact.仅统计保存的明细；未识别项归为未知。: Saved details only. Unidentified entries are grouped under Unknown.
exact.未知死因已合并置底；展开查看已保存线索。: Unknown causes are grouped at the bottom. Expand to see saved evidence.
exact.缺少关联的部分归为未知。: Unlinked entries are grouped under Unknown.
exact.武器与敌人各自汇总；逐敌人武器关联未取得。: Weapon and enemy totals are separate; per-enemy weapon links are unavailable.
exact.AR-2 野狼 制退器: 8mm. Muzzle brake Custom Assault Rifle Large Calibre
exact.R-63CS 反狙击勤勉 制退器: 9mm. Muzzle brake Custom Diligence Counter Sniper
exact.游戏内设置入口尚不可用：需要启用Mod Options Menu；F8仍可使用。: In-game settings unavailable: enable Mod Options Menu. F8 still works.
exact.游戏内设置已注册：ESC → MODS → 战果与战争账单；修改后按应用。: Settings available: ESC > MODS > Combat Awards & War Costs. Apply after making changes.
exact.暂未读到完整数据，保留上次结果。: Full data is not available yet. Keeping the previous result.
exact.在飞船打开自己的完整生涯统计页，保持约3秒，即可同步。: Open your full Career statistics aboard the ship for about 3 seconds to sync.
exact.上舰生涯同步已关闭。: Career sync on ship arrival is off.
exact.上舰后等待生涯数据初始化。: Waiting for Career data to initialize aboard the ship.
exact.等待生涯数据结算，保留现有历史KD。: Waiting for Career totals to settle. Keeping the current Career K/D.
exact.本次上舰生涯同步完成。: Career synced for this ship visit.
exact.本次上舰未完成同步；下次上舰再试，可手动打开生涯页同步。: Career sync did not finish this visit. It will retry on the next ship arrival; opening Career can also sync it.
exact.暂未读到完整生涯数据，保留上次结果。: Full Career data is not available yet. Keeping the previous result.
exact.上舰后自动同步本人生涯数据。: Automatically sync your Career data on arrival aboard the ship.
exact.选择战争账单的显示币种。SC按1 SC＝1 USD折算，仅为本MOD的虚拟军费显: Choose the war bill display currency. SC uses 1 SC = 1 USD as this mod’s virtual military cost display rule.
